mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate directly lowers equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as valuation multiples expand without offsetting earnings deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% triggers market anticipation of Fed rate cuts, producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as liquidity expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS decline and UNRATE rise signals monetary easing in response to labor market weakness, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as growth expectations stabilize.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (FEDFUNDS down and UNRATE up) fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, rising HOUST signals sustained consumer demand growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as earnings momentum accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansions when HOUST rises > 1% MoM over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising INDPRO indicates robust manufacturing output, directly supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises > 0.5% MoM over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1500 thousand units signal strong residential demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as construction sector growth spillovers boost equities.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1500 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising FEDFUNDS signals reduced liquidity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as discount rates compress equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% MoM over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous HOUST and CPIAUCSL increases indicate inflationary demand pressures, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days as markets anticipate aggressive rate hikes.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (HOUST up and CPIAUCSL up) fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.
